newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian index eases in directionless trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian index eases in directionless trade.

text.p: Estonian shares drifted lower in directionless trade on Thursday with overall market turnover down, dealers said.

"Large investors are repositioning themselves, which accounts for most of the trade, which is in large blocks" said one dealer. The Tallinn stock exchange index slipped -0.41 percent to 185.25 on main list volume of 39.2 million kroons.
Hansapank strengthened to close up 2.40 kroons at 177.45 with a volume of 15.8 million kroons.
Savings Bank eased to close at 85.75 kroons down 0.25 kroons after a trade of 9.9 million kroons.
Other stocks were lightly traded. Forekspank turned over 6.2 million kroons to finish up 1.10 kroons at 145.35.
Tallinna Pank was up 0.99 kroons to close at 65.88 kroons on light trade of 2.9 million kroons.
Union Bank closed 0.50 kroons lower at 40.25 kroons with a volume of 2.7 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market was active on business of 23.6 million kroons.
Norma dominated trade on volume of 14.6 million kroons to close up 0.20 at 58.45 kroons.
Rakvere meat plant continued to rise and closed at 16.45 kroons, up 0.95 kroons with volume of 7.4 million kroons.
